subject: general
question: Who among the following legendary Kathak dancers passed away in January 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pandit Birju Maharaj**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Kathak legend Pandit Birju Maharaj passed away (age 83) in January 2022.
 
• Birju Maharaj was a descendant of the Maharaj family of Kathak dancers which includes his two uncles, Shambhu Maharaj and Lachhu Maharaj, and his father and guru, Acchan Maharaj.
 
• He was the recipient of numerous awards for his contributions to the performing arts, including the Padma Vibhushan in 1986.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• In 2021, a book on his life, titled Nritya Samrat Pt. Birju Maharaj was launched.
 
• The book is a compilation of 96 (22 in English and 70 in Hindi) short essays written by his disciples, associates, admirers and senior artists, associates, and well-wishers from around the world.
 
• It has been put together by Nandkishore Kapote, a senior disciple of Birju Maharaj.
 
• Awards received by him include:
 
 
• Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 1964.
 
• Nritya Choodamani Award by Sri Krishna Gana Sabha in 1986.
 
• Kalidas Samman in 1987.
 
• Lata Mangeshkar Puraskar in 2002.
